candidates.title: 2 POTTED JOSEPHINE LILLIES - B...
candidates.reason: Two mature Brunsvigia josephinae bulbs, a slow-growing collector bulb with a specialist market
candidates.findings: Two large mature Brunsvigia josephinae (Josephine's lily) bulbs, each roughly fist to melon sized, sitting high in black nursery pots with new leaf growth. This is a slow-growing collectable South African bulb; flowering-size bulbs take many years and trade among bulb collectors for substantial sums.
candidates.condition: Healthy-looking new leaves, bulb tunics intact; plant tag handwritten and illegible.
candidates.rescore_note: Two Brunsvigia josephinae bulbs, collectable but ID uncertain and niche market; about $80-200.
